description: The estimation format's registered schemas. Add a profile by pull request: its file under profiles/, at least one example record under examples/, and an entry here (see CONTRIBUTING.md). A published entry carries the sha256 of its file and never changes; a fix is a new version.

profiles.name: inference/0.1
profiles.description: Parameters with estimates, standard errors and p-values; a default vcov with type and ssc; nobs and df_residual.

profiles.name: linear-fe/0.1

profiles.name: iv/0.1
